positions.name: ProbeMemoryAssertionVehicle
positions.frame: what is the relationship between a probe memory and the e2e assertion it is built to carry?
positions.why: Both expressions share an informational power signal and present-realis temporal footing around the same e2e enrollment assertion: src-1 declares the settled decision that the suite asserts creator-as-reviewer enrollment on save, and src-2 states this probe memory exists solely to carry that assertion. The conviction gradient (decision vs. claim) is appropriate tension — one establishes the rule, the other explains the artifact's instrumental purpose — and both cohere under the question of how a probe memory relates to the assertion it bears.
